childrenType.description: How this block lays out its children — a children type such as `Unordered` or `Grid`.

columnCount.description: Number of columns the children occupy when `childrenType` is `Grid`.

textAlignment.description: Horizontal alignment of the block's text — a text alignment such as `center`; omitted for the default `left`.

description: A block of LaTeX math, stored as text and rendered with KaTeX.
